# google-docs-mcp

> FastMCP server for Google Docs (content editing, Docs API v1) and Google Drive (file
> lifecycle — search, share, comments, trash — Drive API v3). Runs locally via OAuth
> installed-app flow; no data passes through a third-party server.

See [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) for the complete tool reference, architecture, and
troubleshooting corpus in one file.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it does, quick install, example prompts
- [INSTALL](INSTALL.md): all install paths (drag-and-drop .mcpb, mcpb CLI, manual config, dev mode)
- [Onboarding](docs/ONBOARDING.md): Google Cloud OAuth client setup, cost, pitfalls
- [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md): environment variables
- [Tools](docs/TOOLS.md): full `google_docs` / `google_drive` / `google_docs_auth` operation reference
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): data flow, ports, OAuth flow
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): symptom → fix
- [Development](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): local setup, declared test doubles

## Optional

- [Wrapped APIs](docs/WRAPPEE.md): links to the official Google Docs API and Drive API docs
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
